scientific_question:
Portfolio U=yes independently authorizes one original-Convergence use judgment now. Decide whether the complete I1280 package should enter the same-host optional learning-scheme set alongside authentic D0, or remain exploration evidence with no further unchanged-package spending. The DM recommends limited optional membership, with authentic D0 retained as default/reference and the recorded cost/mixed-history limitations; exploration-only is a genuine alternative. U does not predetermine the answer. Please decide on the accepted evidence, not by requesting another observation first.

All five separately accepted mean I1280−D0 values in J are +0.05697746721968016, +0.206285904082309, −0.012430430599850807, +0.012554805665750726 and +0.0737976491890039. Their positive/adverse final-world signs are24/8,32/0,16/16,19/13 and26/6. Preserve each original .01J MEI reading and conditional uncertainty; do not pool, vote away the negative, select outcomes, or treat five as a statistical quota. Strongest support is the large second and latest gains. Strongest opposition is the negative unchanged pair, adverse worlds, sampled training deficits and I's higher wall in every pair (latest458.80/987.99s D0/I). Earlier batch128 losses remain different-package counterevidence.

The comparison is the full .25-gap/batch1280 I recipe against authentic infinite-gap/batch128 D0, fixed six UAVs/fifty users/H500, five16-lane native training rollouts and one final32-world panel per arm. Both use private recurrent reactive primitive actions while skills are held, the same legal information, primitive-time credit/discount and the accepted learner/evaluator isolation. Renewal, endogenous training rows, advantage grouping, optimizer exposure and learned spatial behavior are not isolated causes. Tuned same-information headroom and final duration statistics are absent. The existing primary comparison remains valid within its B ceiling.

The practical decision is whether this exact recipe can be recommended as an optional same-host learning choice when its additional training cost is acceptable, not whether it universally beats D0. A qualified membership decision changes the direction's documented available scheme set; exploration-only preserves evidence without recommending this use or further unchanged spending. Neither changes the default, lifecycle, paper-level claim, C/transfer/formal-UAV status or funding.

Current U includes exactly one fixed GitHub question, current Root/Transport delivery and full original-DM response intake/publication; complete documentary/invoked/provider/agent cost is explicitly accepted UNKNOWN. Zero implementation, model/load/RNG, numerical reanalysis, fit, additional evaluation or profiling is included. B-LONG-D0 is entirely outside U and must not become an option, required observation or automatic next action. No sixth unchanged pair or automatic follow-up consultation follows either answer.
deliverable:
Return one conclusion-first final use decision: limited optional membership alongside authentic D0, or exploration-only with no further unchanged-package spending. State exact permissible use wording and its immediate documentary consequence, then explain the strongest support, strongest contradiction, conditional uncertainty and why the complete package interpretation fits the evidence. Distinguish accepted observation, DM recommendation and your node decision. Retain every pair and the original MEI branches without numerical reanalysis or new aggregate uncertainty.

Keep the decision inside the two offered uses and current owner-directed FSD continuation. The renderer's generic Convergence continue/park/close/recast wording applies here only to this package's use recommendation; whole-direction lifecycle, a new mechanism/recast/funding and scientific invocation are outside U. If optional membership is unsupported, complete U with the narrower exploration-only answer and its reason rather than making an unallocated experiment, stronger comparator, full causal diagnosis, exact headroom or another consultation a prerequisite. A later need may be described only as a concrete future revisit condition, without selecting or funding an experiment.

Use supplied accepted results/exposure/cost facts and named method passages only. Identify actual access and any decision-critical gap or concrete current-spec conflict. No new library research, full replay, source execution, numerical recomputation or mechanism enumeration is requested. The five-pair history is B/EXPLORE, not a stable performance guarantee. Full U cost remains UNKNOWN; zero learner work is not zero total cost. Publish the complete answer in the one scoped response file and delivery comment, retaining the in-turn downloadable Markdown fallback if scoped GitHub writes are unavailable after actual-state readback.
